The change replaces passing `snapshots` unchanged with `pd.Index(list(snapshots), tupleize_cols=False, name="snapshot")`, unconditionally forcing a flat index. For a network with MultiIndex snapshots and `optimization.model_snapshot_index = "multiindex"` under legacy linopy semantics, this converts an accepted MultiIndex into flat tuple labels before passing it to optimisation, regardless of the selected representation.
